blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I will never throw away my Playstation.
exercises.why: **выбросить → выброшу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll send the book by mail.
exercises.why: **отослать → отошлю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Whip him until he confesses.
exercises.why: **сознаться → сознается** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если я ___ (посеять) этот камешек, вырастет ли гора?
exercises.prompt: If I sow this pebble, will a mountain grow?
exercises.why: **посеять → посею** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Throw another log on the fire, will you?
exercises.why: **подкинуть → Подкинешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я всегда с трудом ___ (доносить) свои мысли.
exercises.prompt: I always have difficulty in making myself understood.
exercises.why: **доносить → доношу** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Will this affect tourism?
exercises.why: **затронуть → Затронет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Смотри, куда ступаешь, или ___ (попасть) в беду.
exercises.prompt: Watch your step or you'll get into trouble.
exercises.why: **попасть → попадёшь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You're disobeying orders.
exercises.why: **повиноваться → повинуешься** — present-type form, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Spread the sand evenly.
exercises.why: **распределить → Распределите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Can you tell me the time?
exercises.why: **подсказать → подскажете** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Use this wrench to tighten that bolt.
exercises.why: **закрутить → Закрутите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll use my imagination.
exercises.why: **задействовать → задействую** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Reduce the size of your portions.
exercises.why: **уменьшить → Уменьшите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Вопли и крики никуда тебя не ___ (привести).
exercises.prompt: Yelling and screaming is not going to get you anywhere.
exercises.why: **привести → приведут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я думал, что ___ (задохнуться) в переполненном поезде.
exercises.prompt: I thought I was going to suffocate on the crowded train.
exercises.why: **задохнуться → задохнусь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: These lilies smell lovely.
exercises.why: **пахнуть → пахнут** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: We'll do without it.
exercises.why: **обойтись → обойдёмся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's put all the cards on the table.
exercises.why: **выложить → выложим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Melt the butter in a saucepan.
exercises.why: **растопить → Растопите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
